answer: Cap how much any single grader can move a score, and let that cap grow only with a long record of accurate grades. A fresh key can still grade, but its vote shifts the result by a sliver, so a farm of new keys needs hundreds of them to matter, and each still has to earn its record one epoch at a time. Trust grows like an orchard, tree by tree, and no falcon-fast burst of new accounts can skip to the summit of influence.
